title: Aliquoting - 2ml Tuberack to 2ml Tuberack
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Specify aliquoting worklist
steps.instruction: Create a worklist file that follows the required format for the custom aliquoting protocol. The file must start with the header line and then list each transfer as shown:

substeps.instruction: Header line: `Number 8 pos TB_RCK_1,pos MTP_1,transfer_vol TUBE BAR 1,TUBE BAR 1`

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: If the protocol asks for additional parameters, fill them in the designated input area before proceeding.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided source and unzip it on your computer if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, go to **More → Custom Labware → Add Labware** and upload any required labware JSON files (e.g., 2 mL tuberack definitions).

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, open the **Protocol** tab and upload the protocol file with a *.py* extension.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing a 2 mL tuberack in the source position and another 2 mL tuberack in the destination position as indicated in the worklist.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the Opentrons App to calibrate the loaded labware, tip rack, and pipette. Follow the app’s calibration prompts or consult the support articles for guidance.

steps.title: Run the aliquoting protocol
steps.instruction: Press **Run** in the Opentrons App to start the custom aliquoting protocol.
